verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API, and a probe confirms it at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so an agent can connect to the Stripe platform that hosts Issuing. However, the evidence never shows that this MCP server exposes Issuing-specific tools such as card or cardholder creation, spending controls, or authorizations, so coverage of this story for Issuing is only implied. missing for 10: documented Issuing-specific MCP tools, connection/auth setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the MCP server with Issuing

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe’s knowledge base
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
